findings: Orders ship in 1.6 days (vs 1.7 expected) and arrive in 4.7 days (vs 5.3 advertised).

actions: Chase FedEx on CS680345833 and check pickup scanning at the NJ warehouse.
Tighten carrier hand-off so parcels are scanned the same day (fixes induction fill rate).
Review lead-time settings — a 1-day handling time could earn fast-delivery badges.

sales-performance.headline: August revenue −24.7% YoY; traffic −60%; 72% of live SKUs sold nothing in 90 days

findings: Revenue fell much faster than units (−24.7% vs −5.4%): the average selling price dropped ~20%, in line with continuous discounting.
Visits fell 60% while conversion more than doubled — fewer, better-qualified shoppers. Lost ad visibility (see Advertising) is a likely contributor.
Bath Rugs & Mats is 96.7% of revenue ($20,913); Bath Towels grew from a tiny base ($404, +361%); Area Rugs fell 48%.

actions: Restart advertising on the top 100 SKUs to recover traffic.
Prune or consolidate zero-sale variants so traffic concentrates on listings that convert.
Grow Bath Towels (fast-growing) with ads and Way Day submissions.

The traffic collapse (−60% YoY visits in August) lines up with ads going dark.
Active campaign daily caps total $135/day but the wallet cap is $100/day, so campaigns would be throttled even when funded.
34 Wayfair campaign recommendations (1 new-product, 33 high-potential) are waiting.

actions: Confirm invoice 1581388 clears, then set up auto-pay (trigger balance + amount) so ads never go dark again.
Raise the wallet daily cap to at least the sum of active campaign caps, or trim campaign caps.
Launch the 33 high-potential recommendations, and point “Top Priority SKUs” at the current top 100 SKUs.
Re-check ROAS two weeks after spend resumes.

plan.title: Top up the ad wallet and turn on auto-pay
plan.why: Ads have served nothing for 28+ days and visits are down 60% YoY. August revenue was $7,100 below last year; restoring sponsored visibility is the fastest way to win part of that back.
steps: Confirm prepaid invoice 1581388 ($1,500) has cleared.
Wallet → Set Up Automatic Payments: trigger at $300, top up $1,500.
Raise the wallet daily cap from $100 to at least $135 (sum of active campaign caps).
Point “Top Priority SKUs” at the current top 100 sellers (see Sales Performance → revenue list).

plan.title: Restock the 155 out-of-stock SKUs that were selling
plan.why: These SKUs sold $10,352 in the last 90 days and now have zero available. 12 are top-50 sellers.
steps: Open Inventory Health → “Out-of-stock SKUs” (sorted by recent sales) and download the CSV.
Restock the top rows first (BLUX2PC1721TC, BWA4PC17212022TC, BHAM2154GY/NA, BALL3PC172120PI, TWI12PC131627YE…).
Submit inventory in Partner Home the same day stock lands.

plan.title: Relist the three Not Live families that were selling
plan.why: FBWX1917 (Bruss Luxury, 44 variants), OPCO4702 and FBWX1956 sold $2,101 in 90 days before going offline.
steps: Product Management → filter Status: Not Live → search FBWX1917, OPCO4702, FBWX1956.
Check the reason shown (stock, compliance, content) and fix it; submit inventory if it is a stock issue.

plan.title: Submit best sellers to Way Day, 5 Days of Deals and the October 48HR sales
plan.why: Four events are open and not submitted. WFNA 5 Days of Deals and WFNA 48HR Sale close 25 Sep; Way Day and NA 48HR Sale close 2 Oct.
steps: Submit only the top 100 sellers (Promotions → Top 100 sellers list) rather than the whole catalog.
Use a deeper discount for Way Day than the always-on 10% so the event actually stands out.

plan.title: Fix the 263 high-traffic, low-conversion listings
plan.why: These live SKUs get ≥ 50 visits but convert under 1% — e.g. BMO1724PI (1,964 visits, 0.61%), BWA1724LI (1,827, 0.22%). Shoppers find them but don’t buy.
steps: Open Sales Performance → “High traffic, low conversion” and work down the list.
For each: compare price vs similar Wayfair listings, check photos and size/colour accuracy, read the latest reviews.
Fill missing attributes (sizes, materials) so the listing matches filters.

plan.title: Fill missing attributes on the top 100 sellers
plan.why: The top 100 SKUs earn 32% of revenue but miss a median of 133 attributes. Attributes power Wayfair filters and search ranking.
steps: Download the Listing Health → attributes list (sorted by revenue).
Product Management → Update from File → download the attribute template for those SKUs, fill it, upload.

plan.title: Stop always-on discounting; test full price
plan.why: Every live SKU carries the 10% Q3 Extended discount through 19 Nov, with events stacked on top. Average selling price fell ~20% YoY while units fell only 5%.
steps: Pick 200 steady sellers and remove them from the next extended-discount event.
Compare their conversion and units for 2 weeks against similar SKUs still discounted.
Keep discounts for event days only if full price holds conversion.

plan.title: Prune or fix 3,325 zero-sale SKUs
plan.why: 72% of live SKUs sold nothing in 90 days; 883 of them are also out of stock. 387 get ≥ 20 visits and just need a better offer.
steps: Discontinue out-of-stock zero-sellers you won’t restock.
For zero-sellers with ≥ 20 visits, check price and content first.

plan.title: Fix the low-rated families and the #1 seller’s 3.81★
plan.why: BWA4PC17212022 is the #1 seller but rates 3.81★ across 1,117 reviews; six families rate below 3.5★.
steps: Read the most recent 1–2★ reviews for each family and list the recurring complaint.
Fix the product or the listing (size/colour accuracy), or delist families below 3.3★.

plan.title: Earn fast-delivery badges
plan.why: Orders ship in 1.6 days and arrive in 4.7, yet only 1% show a fast-delivery badge. Fixing carrier induction (87.2%) and lead times unlocks badges.
steps: Get FedEx to scan parcels on pickup day (fixes induction fill rate).
Review lead-time settings; set 1-day handling where the NJ warehouse can meet it.
